observable_failure_step: Markdown formatting, Word DOCX generation, and table rendering phases.
root_cause_diagnosis: The defect stems from five mechanical oversights: 1. `academic_docgen.py` unconditionally injects document titles, ignoring pre-existing Markdown `#` headings, causing duplication. 2. Generators emit two-line table captions in Markdown, violating the single-line standard. 3. Agents translate standard statistical symbols (M, SD, p) into verbose Persian phrases, breaking APA conventions. 4. The DOCX generator omits the `<w:bidiVisual/>` XML tag in `table._tbl.tblPr`, causing table layouts to visually default to LTR instead of RTL. 5. The table cell population routine directly pipes Markdown (`**`) and LaTeX (`$`) syntax into Word without a parsing/stripping step.
prescribed_behavior: 1. Modify `academic_docgen.py` to conditionally skip title insertion if a top-level Markdown heading is detected. 2. Strictly format all table captions on a single line: `جدول [فصل]- [شماره]: [عنوان]`. 3. Enforce retention of Latin APA statistical symbols (`M`, `SD`, `SE`, `t`, `F`, `p`, `z`, `B`, `β`, `df`, `R²`) in all Persian tables. 4. Update the docx table generation logic to explicitly inject the `<w:bidiVisual/>` element into table properties for RTL alignment. 5. Implement a sanitization filter to strip `**` and `$` delimiters before injecting text into DOCX table cells.
